implementation.summary: Removed three simultaneous auto-start launches from this dockview-only fixture. The PR watcher still creates the same three tasks and provider refs. The spec now ensures each real primary session sequentially, waits for its workspace to be ready and session to remain CREATED, refreshes the kanban snapshot, starts task 1 with the visible Start Agent control, then runs the existing plan-mode and dockview task-switch assertions.
fixture_proofs: Each watcher-created task is matched by title and Review workflow step.
Each ensure call returns a CREATED primary session before the next task is prepared.
The task primary_session_id matches the ensured session id.
Each task environment reaches ready with a non-empty workspace path before the next is prepared.
Task 1 starts through task-description-start-button and must reach the existing idle or recovery condition before plan mode is toggled.
All existing task-switch, no-layout-gap, no-plan-leak, Changes/Chat visibility, and three-distinct-workspaces assertions remain.

synthetic_merge_commit.note: The run API later reported PR base aebac5d5395e9983124b398198bace146d38506b; the signed synthetic merge commit records the actual run merge parent as 997bc54fae4da15702c91da5c5d120bfe651edc1.

ci_failure_evidence.identity: chromium::tests/pr/pr-watcher-dockview-layout.spec.ts::PR watcher dockview layout stability > layout remains correct when switching between PR watcher tasks with plan mode

initial_failed_attempt.error: the session layout did not reach an idle or recovery state; Playwright poll timed out after 60000ms
initial_failed_attempt.dom_evidence: The page showed the task launch-error banner: 'The workspace could not be prepared for this launch. Launch needs attention.' The terminal was still connecting.

passing_retry_trace.attribution: passing retry context only; excluded as evidence for the initial failure

ci_failure_evidence.underlying_launch_error_details: Unavailable: initial attempt had no trace and the captured page left Show details collapsed.

causality_and_limits.basis: CI's failed screenshot proves a task workspace launch-error state. It does not expose the underlying error details. The unchanged fixture launched all three agent/worktree setups together; the revised fixture serializes environment preparation and passed five local repetitions. The data supports a contention hypothesis but does not prove the initial checkout failure was caused by that concurrency.
